package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `prisma`,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`model User { id Int @id }`, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
